1.title: Make a loop in the rope
1.say: Hold the long hanging part steady in your left hand. Bring the short loose end across the front and to the left. Leave a big open loop hanging below the cross.
placements: short loose end of your rope → across the front of the long hanging part to the left, leaving a large open loop hanging below the cross (in the video: end points left, loop hangs down to the lower right in the center of the frame)
watch_for: If the end goes behind instead of across the front, the cross will hide the end and the loop will twist open.
If the loop is tiny, you will not be able to push the end through later, so start with a loop as big as your fist.
1.check_yourself: It should look like one open loop hanging below with the short end lying across the front like the top of the number 6.

2.title: Wrap the end around behind
2.say: Take the short loose end behind the long hanging part. Bring it around to the right side.
placements: short loose end of your rope → behind the long hanging part and around to the right side, forming a twist at the cross above the lower loop (in the video: end sticks out to the right behind the upright part, loop hangs straight below)
watch_for: If you bring the end around the front instead of behind, the top will look flat with no clear twist.
If you let go of the first cross, the bottom loop collapses and you lose the open shape, so keep pinching the cross.
2.check_yourself: It should look like a twist pinched at the top with an open loop hanging below and the short end sticking out sideways behind.

3.title: Push the end through and tighten
3.say: Push the short loose end through the big bottom loop. Pull the long part and the short end apart to tighten.
placements: short loose end of your rope → through the inside of the large bottom loop to the middle, then pulled down while the long hanging part is pulled up until snug (in the video: tight upright eight in the center with the short tail hanging straight down below the knot)
watch_for: If you go through the small top twist instead of the big bottom loop, you will not get two even stacked loops.
If you do not pull it snug, the eight looks loose and wobbly and slides, so pull both ends firmly apart.
3.check_yourself: It should look like a neat figure eight with one loop above and one loop below and a short end hanging straight down.
